result.brief: 提出预测状态流（PSF），将扩散先验用于生成高层预测状态、解码器负责块内 token 决策，把 L 个 token 级状态压缩为 K 个预测状态并降低序列深度，提升连续扩散语言模型生成效率与质量。
result.reason: Continuous diffusion language model with rectified-flow prior over predictive states and block-causal decoder; directly addresses continuous latent/token design, matching continuous language model direction.
